requiredBehaviors.behavior: link every material obligation to a control or visible gap
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Quality gate requires a control or visible gap for each material obligation.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate control design from operating effectiveness
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Status discipline separates designed/implemented-unverified from operating-effective.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: define testable evidence and ownership for each control
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Control design requires owner, evidence and testability.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: mark controls effective without assurance evidence
create controls with no obligation or risk rationale
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Mapping chain and gap analysis require obligation/risk rationale.
